{{Quote|This massive fortress dominated by a deadly planetary defense gun has long been the symbol of Gamorrean strength and power.|[[Dax Gazaway]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Racer Revenge">''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''</ref>}}
A '''planetary defense gun''' was a huge piece of artillery. The [[Citadel (Gamorr)|Citadel]] of [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] possessed one.

==Behind the scenes==
The planetary defense gun first appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]].''
